test_title: PYST 16: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one that follows the same logic.

CAFE - CEAF - ECFA

ABLY - AYBL - YALB
solution:
The logic followed here is:

CAFE - CEAF - ECFA

 
 C A F E pos2, pos2->pos3, pos3->pos4 --> 
• 
• 
• 
• C E A F pos1, pos1->pos2, pos4->pos3, pos3->pos4 --> 
• 
• 
• 
• E C F A 

And,

ABLY - AYBL - YALB

 
 A B L Y pos2, pos2->pos3, pos3->pos4 --> 
• 
• 
• 
• A Y B L pos1, pos1->pos2, pos4->pos3, pos3->pos4 --> 
• 
• 
• 
• Y A L B 

Similarly,

ECHO - EOCH - OEHC

 
 E C H O pos2, pos2->pos3, pos3->pos4 --> 
• 
• 
• 
• E O C H pos1, pos1->pos2, pos4->pos3, pos3->pos4 --> 
• 
• 
• 
• O E H C 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
